title: 竹溪試浴（1967.145）
title_orig: Bamboo and Ducks by a Rushing Stream
holder: 克利夫兰美术馆（藏品号 1967.145）
medium: hanging scroll; ink and light color on silk
one_line: 克利夫兰美术馆藏画作，馆方断代作「1127–1279」。**本条为著录级**：照录馆方记录，未作阐释。

rows: Bamboo and Ducks by a Rushing Stream
hanging scroll; ink and light color on silk
Purchase from the J. H. Wade Fund

basics.text: **本条为著录级条目。**以上各项照录克利夫兰美术馆的藏品记录，字段名标明「馆方」者即其原文。本库尚未对其作独立核校，亦未就断代、归属、风格作任何判断——分期归入依据仅为：朝代名 → southern-song；器类归入依据仅为：type=Painting。

items: Tu Mu (traditional attribution). T'ieh-wang san-hu [鐵網珊瑚 = Corals in an Iron Net]. Preface by Shen Te-ch'ien dated 1758. Taipei: National Central Library 國立中央圖書館, 1970.（ch. 8, p. 1(a)）
“Year in Review.” The Bulletin of the Cleveland Museum of Art 54, no. 10 (December 1967): 302–346.（Reporouced: p. 335; Mentioned: p. 347, no. 162）
The Cleveland Museum of Art. Handbook of the Cleveland Museum of Art/1969. Cleveland, OH: The Cleveland Museum of Art, 1969.（Reproduced: p. 259）
Lee, Sherman E. "Painting." In Quality: Its Image in the Arts. Edited by Louis Kronenberger, pp. 113–145. New York: Atheneum, 1969.（Mentioned: p. 121; Reproduced: p. 137, color pl.）
Etō, Shun. "'Ba En kan Chikuen zu' Kinuhon bokuga tansai" [Bamboo and Swallows attributed to Ma Yuan]. Yamato Bunka 大和文華 no. 51 (November 1969).（Reproduced: fig. 2）
**馆方记录另有 8 条著录未在此列出。**

dating.text: 馆方给出了年代，**但未在公开记录中说明这个年代依据什么**——是铭文、器形序列、共出器物还是风格比对，无从得知。本库的断代十档因此无法填写：**填任何一档都是替馆方作了它没作的声明。**

colophons.text:
馬遠
